title: Clarify literature-search retrieval boundary
description: Narrows literature-search to paper retrieval, screening, and source verification, with explicit handoff to literature-research for field mapping, gap discovery, research direction recommendation, and idea ranking.
changes: Rewrite the skill description so the model sees literature-search as retrieval execution rather than research synthesis.
Add a boundary section distinguishing retrieval/corpus work from field maps, gap maps, and idea banks.
Add a Research Synthesis Handoff intent so research-direction requests load literature-research.
Preserve existing web-first lookup and arc_search_literature retrieval guidance.

rollback.notes: Restore unified routing behavior where literature-search could own broader review synthesis.
